title: Layer cutoff exponential bound
statement: Let $s$ be a positive natural number and let $\varepsilon>0$. Define the layer cutoff $L$ to be the least natural number greater than or equal to $\log_2(2s/\varepsilon)$. Then $s(1/2)^L\le \varepsilon/2$.
